title: Switch Tools
description: This simple mod will replace any broken tool in your hand with another of the same type from your inventory.
body:
This simple mod will replace any broken tool in your hand with another of the same type from your inventory, prioritizing those that are exactly the same as the broken item; otherwise, it will pick up an item with the same capacity.

The tools covered are: Axes, Pickaxes, Shovels, and Hoes.
